channel.secretAlreadySet: {{label}} (already set, leave empty to keep unchanged)

zabbix.description: Ready-to-import monitoring templates for the /metrics endpoint. Requires METRICS_TOKEN (panel environment variable).

ifaceUpdown.label: Interface up/down
ifaceUpdown.tooltip: The VPN interface on the server (the provider itself) came up or went down — not related to individual clients

siteConnect.label: Site connected
siteConnect.tooltip: A peer with the "Site" category (a remote site's gateway, added as "Site (mesh)" when the client was created) came online

siteDisconnect.label: Site disconnected
siteDisconnect.tooltip: A peer with the "Site" category stopped responding (e.g. the handshake was lost)

clientConnect.label: Client connected
clientConnect.tooltip: A regular client (not a "Site") came online

unknownPeer.label: Unknown peer on interface
unknownPeer.tooltip: A peer not present in the panel's database appeared on the interface — for example, added manually on the host, bypassing the panel

enable.label: Enable report
enable.tooltip: Send a summary on a schedule, not only on events

includeEvents.label: Include events
includeEvents.tooltip: Attach the list of events that occurred during the period to the summary

includeStatus.label: Include server status
includeStatus.tooltip: Attach the current status (up/down, clients online) of all providers to the summary

provider.label: Provider
provider.tooltip: The name of the VPN provider/server the event relates to

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.tooltip: The network address (IP:port) the peer connected from

address.label: Address
address.tooltip: The peer's VPN address inside the tunnel

time.label: Time
time.tooltip: The exact time of the event
